comparator.academicYear: Current 2026–2027 WUR programme and published 2025/2026 course scheme, checked 2026-09-28
comparator.sourceNotes: The official three-year bachelor totals 180 EC. Years 1 and 2 each account for 60 EC across chemistry, mathematics, statistics, cell biology, genetics, zoology, plant biology, ecology, evolution, physiology, microbiology, development, behaviour, modelling, ethics and practical biological skills. Published background-dependent and specialisation choices are preserved generically. Year 3 is represented as 6 EC advanced statistics, a 24-EC four-month independent thesis and 30 EC of genuine specialisation/free-choice study.

Molecular/cellular health biology and ecology/evolution/conservation are independently evidenced, coherent and substantively distinct. All three are mechanically feasible; production stops at the maximum.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both establish broad cellular and molecular foundations for later biology.
Both develop molecular cell biology and microbial or biochemical mechanisms.
Both study integrated human and animal physiological systems.
UCR provides practical laboratory skills supporting later biological specialisation.
Both introduce biodiversity and organism–environment relationships.
Both develop ecosystem, population and community ecology.
Both examine evolutionary mechanisms and biological diversification.
